newsitem.title: UK: UK meals and feeds higher. active trade in soymeal.
newsitem.headline: UK meals and feeds higher. active trade in soymeal.

text.p: Brokers on the UK meals and feeds market reported active trading in high protein soymeal on Thursday.
"There were some low prices around early this morning and a number of people jumped in quick," said one broker.
Brokers said March high protein soymeal was trading between 241 and 242.50 stg a tonne ex-store east coast.
"We don't know what tonnage is involved but by all accounts it's good," said another broker.
Imported European Union rapemeal traded at 134 stg for spot ex-store Teignmouth.
High pro sellers ex-mill were up two to three stg a tonne following the higher close in Chicago on Wednesday while stores were two to 4.50 stg up.
Rapemeal ex-mill Erith was unchanged for old crop and three stg higher for new crop.
The Liverpool and Hull mills were three stg down to unchanged.
Corn gluten feed pellets, sunflower pellets and sunmeal were all unchanged.
